Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding displays of state and federal documents in public buildings on the capitol campus.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to displays of state and federal documents inpublic buildings on the state capitol campus; and adding a new sectionto chapter 43.19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of general administration must develop and maintaina public display of the state Constitution, the federal Constitution,and the Declaration of Independence. The department may include in adisplay other historical legal documents that are fundamental inshaping the political system of the United States after consultationwith members of the house of representatives committee on generalgovernment appropriations. (1) The display must be placed in the state capitol building in anarea accessible to the public and obvious to visitors. (2) The display must be in a form to allow the public to examinethe text of the documents. The display must be permanent and ongoing p. 1 HB 2832and may be movable.
